T: The Guardians are coming to dinner.
D: Jack Frost joins Santa, the Easter Bunny, the Tooth Fairy and the Sandman to stop the Bogeyman.
P: Serve the sweets when the Easter Bunny's egg hunt begins.
S: North's workshop full of yetis and elves

Spiced gingerbread cut into yetis and elves, iced with fluffy white fur and tiny red hats, the cookies the elves keep sneaking. Melt 100g butter with 100g golden syrup and 80g brown sugar. Mix in 300g self-raising flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 egg. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm, cut into big gingerbread men for yetis and small ones for elves, and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix 200g icing sugar with 2 tbsp water, pipe shaggy white fur on the yetis and tint a little red for the elves' hats.
Sandy and his golden dream sand

Crunchy homemade honeycomb, half dipped in milk chocolate and dusted with edible gold, glittering like dream sand. Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper. Heat 200g caster sugar and 5 tbsp golden syrup in a deep pan, stirring until dissolved, then boil without stirring until deep golden, about 5 minutes. Take off the heat, quickly whisk in 2 tsp bicarb and pour into the tin without spreading. Set for 1 hour, then break into chunks. Dip half of each chunk in 100g melted milk chocolate and dust with edible gold glitter.
M: North, the Guardian with the big Russian accent

Seared beef strips and mushrooms in a creamy paprika, mustard and sour cream sauce, over buttery egg noodles with dill. Slice 600g rump into thin strips and sear in batches in a hot pan with oil for 1 minute. Remove. Fry 1 sliced onion and 300g sliced mushrooms in 30g butter for 6 minutes. Add 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1 tbsp Dijon and 300ml beef stock and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in 200g sour cream and the beef and warm through without boiling. Cook 400g egg noodles, toss in butter and dill and serve under the beef.
W: Bunnymund's hot cross bun egg pudding

Hot cross buns baked in a vanilla custard until puffed and golden, studded with melting mini chocolate eggs and served with cream. Butter and halve 6 hot cross buns and lay them in a baking dish, cut-side up and overlapping. Tuck 100g mini chocolate eggs between them. Whisk 3 eggs, 400ml milk, 200ml cream, 60g caster sugar and 1 tsp vanilla and pour over. Stand 15 minutes. Bake at 170C for 35 minutes until set and golden. Dust with icing sugar and serve warm with cream and a few more mini eggs.
K: Jack Frost and his icy staff

Icy blue lemonade slushie with fresh lime and mint, in glasses with sugar-frosted rims that look like Jack's frost. Dip the rims of 4 glasses in lime juice, then in caster sugar, and freeze for 10 minutes. Blend 3 cups ice with 120ml blue cordial, the juice of 2 limes and a few mint leaves until slushy. Add 600ml cold lemonade and pulse twice. Pour into the frosted glasses and garnish with a mint sprig.
